bugs.text: Enemies are created with formation:true and state 'pending'. They never fly in and keep state 'pending', and player shots skip 'pending' enemies, so no enemy in formation can ever be shot. The play-test bot scored 0 hits in 75 s.
SLOT_X has 8 entries but col 8 is used: 1 Boss and 2 Goei get NaN positions, so they are invisible, unhittable and never die.

samplePath runs every segment over the full cubic, so divers reach the bottom halfway, teleport back up, and end at exactly y=H+20. The 'y>H+20' return check never passes, so divers stay stuck below the screen for good.
Stage 1 can never be cleared. Once all divers are stuck the game soft-locks, and challenge stages, stage flow and extra ships are unreachable.
rand(a,b) uses (b-b) and always returns a: fixed fire timers, overlapping escorts, and all challenge enemies on one path.
Sprite colour letters are not keys of PAL, so every sprite renders white.
Boss Galaga dies in one hit; there is no colour change.
Being captured automatically gives the next ship a dual fighter 2.4 s later. The captive is never pulled up or held, and never fires.
Shooting a beaming boss leaves its tractor beam drawn on screen permanently (beamBoss is never cleared).
A hit on the dual fighter loses the whole ship, not one half.
Escorts are glued to the boss, overlap, never fire, and stay attached.
No 'STAGE N' at stage start; it is drawn only after a stage clears.
The canvas is not scaled to the window; it shows at native 224x288.
Breathing scales about x=0, so the formation drifts right/left and goes off the playfield edge.
Challenge wave bonus and PERFECT never trigger; NUMBER OF HITS never shows.
Stage badge is one cycling denomination, not the arcade combination.

summary: The file is tidy-looking, loads without errors, and has a correct fixed-timestep loop, HUD, title screen, high-score storage, shot limit, results screen and respawn/READY handling. The core game, though, is broken by a handful of logic bugs. Enemies spawn straight into the formation and keep a 'pending' state that the collision code skips, so the formation can never be shot (the play-test bot got 0 hits in 75 s and both games ended by ramming). Three formation slots index past the end of SLOT_X and become invisible, unkillable NaN enemies. The dive path sampler teleports divers and leaves them stuck just below the screen, so stage 1 can never be cleared, and challenge stages, stage advance and extra ships are unreachable. rand() always returns its lower bound, and a palette key mismatch makes every sprite white. The signature tractor-beam mechanic is only a widening cone: capture is not animated or held, and the dual fighter is handed out automatically after any capture. What you can do is move, fire, dodge dives and die, so it resembles Galaga only on the surface.
